releases.notes:
This update contains update for Minecraft 26.3, and whole batch of bug fixes. Bug fixes are mostly focused on lyric screen.

 - Added diagnostic dump feature
 - Changed key binding name
 - Fixed button hitbox size
 - Improved token expiration handling
 - Fixed lyric screen's margin being too wide
 - Fixed texts on sub-screens not being centered
 - Fixed background being too bright on near-white color album images
 - Fixed dark background detection not working on black background
 - Fixed lyric not reloading when staying on lyric screen after song changes
 - Last loaded lyric is cached
 - Fix Spotify developer dashboard not opening in new tab
 - Fixed next song loading too slow after song change
 - Fixed lyric height counting being shorter than actual height
 - Updated to 26.3. 
 
26.3 has obscure behaviors that I can't reliably recreate, so there might be some bugs.

releases.notes:
This release update for Minecraft 26.2, and some minor bug fixes. I've also made some improvements on lyric screen.

 - Updated for Minecraft 26.2
 - Fixed a issue where song doesn't update properly after skipping
 - Fixed a issue where string is sometimes cut off wrongly
 - Fixed a issue where guide page's encoding is broken in Korean
 - Mod now give user interaction feedback when you add a song to queue
 - Lyric screen improvements
 - Screens no longer pauses the game

releases.notes:
This release contains bug fixes, and experimental features in development that didn't make it to previous release.

 - Added lyric support
 - Cursor don't move to top-left automatically ([#33](https://github.com/IamTiji/spotify-controller/issues/33))
 - Fixed broken string when you don't play anything
 - Fixed a memory leak
 - Song screen now closes when you press 'Z' (or other key if you changed it) ([#16](https://github.com/IamTiji/spotify-controller/issues/16))
 - User-Agent is now written properly
 - Updated to support 26.1 and 26.1.1
